consequence.statement: No operational consequence for operators: this change only upgrades Pebble (the ACME test server used by cert-manager's own end-to-end tests) to v2.7.0 and updates those tests to match; shipped cert-manager behavior and configuration are unaffected (the release notes classify it under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)").

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 upgraded Pebble, the ACME test server used by its own end-to-end tests, to v2.7.0 and adjusted those tests to match the latest Pebble behavior; the change is confined to the test suite and has no operational consequence for cert-manager deployments.
